This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Cy Yunga]] was a member of this species.

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|dark green]] skin, as well as their long necks with heads featuring only one wide [[Eye/Legends|eye]] with a green iris, and no other facial features.<ref name="EIR" />

==Society and culture==
One member of this species, [[Cy Yunga]], was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]<ref name="EIR" /> active during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The racing season presented in the [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' must have taken place during this year due to the appearances of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which correspond to ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[1999]]<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/1999/05/18/star-wars-hits-the-shelves|text=Star Wars Hits The Shelves|author=IGN Staff|date=1999-05-18|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20121121210047}}</ref> video game [[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]. In said game, Cy Yunga's model borrows the body from the model of the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] pilot [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], though with a new texture.<ref name="EIR" />
